$comment: Source of truth: pillar manifest JSON on disk (operator-controlled config). Not a DHT entry; the entries this schema describes live in elohim/sdk/domains/<pillar>/manifest.json under the attestations section. See spec §6.1.
title: ManifestAttestationDeclaration
description: Per-subtype attestation declaration inside a pillar manifest's attestations section. Source of truth is the manifest JSON file on disk.

subject_kinds.description: Which kinds of subject this attestation subtype is permitted to target

$ref.description: Relative path to the per-subtype metadata schema, e.g. ../../schemas/v1/attestation/subtypes/humanness-metadata.schema.json

authorization_predicate.description: Optional predicate enforced at coordinator-zome time when an attestation of this kind is issued. Null means any agent may issue.

uniqueness_anchor.description: Optional anchor template for issuer-unique-per-subject attestations. Variables: {kind}, {subject_cid}, {issuer_cid}, {parent_cid}. Null means duplicates are allowed.

revocable_by.description: Who may issue a revocation attestation that supersedes an existing one of this kind
